original_text:
Not hearing back after requesting a referral?

Here’s a template that gets me a reply 9/10 times 🔥

Hi {{Name}},

I hope you're doing well! I came across a [Job Title] opening at [Company Name] and would love to apply. Sharing my details for a referral:
🟢 Job ID/Job Link
🟢 Name
🟢 Years of Experience
🟢 Key Skills (5-6 max)
🟢 Resume link or attachment
🟢 Email & Phone Number
🟢 Portfolio/Coding profile (if relevant)

Would really appreciate your help! Let me know if you need any more details.

Thanks,
{{Your Name}}

→ For a referral to work, your profile should match at least 70-80% of the JD. So, focus on building your skills first. You can also take help from senior SDEs on hiring panels to ensure you stand out, even without relying on referrals.
Just connect with them for FREE here: https://lnkd.in/gavb5GmW

They will help you with your resume, upskilling, interview preparation, job applications and YES, even referrals. 🚀
Try it out!

#referraltemplates #referraltips #collab #preplacedcollab #jobsearch #upskilling

ai_analysis.summary: The post provides a template for requesting a job referral and recommends including the job link, experience, key skills, resume, contact details, and a coding profile when relevant. It claims the template gets a reply nine out of ten times and that a referral profile should match at least 70–80% of a job description. It also promotes free career support for resume review, upskilling, interview preparation, applications, and referrals. The content contains no substantive data engineering or other technical knowledge.
